On Wed, Apr 14, 2027 at 14:35, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> - Wed 2027-04-14 13:30–14:00 PT — Michael Chan (Productivex) — Marissa + Michael (phone) — note taker: Vivek Kulkarni

Following up with the brief notes from both calls (as promised). I pasted the questionnaire bullets into the summary below for Laura and the hiring panel.

Dana Ortiz (manager) — 30m, video
- Scope: Managed Zoe directly on an ML infrastructure rewrite, 18 months.
- Strengths: fast iteration on prototypes, strong sense of ownership, clear communicator with senior engineers.
- Areas: needed more structure for cross-team prioritization early on; improved after 2 quarters.
- Impact: drove a perf optimization that reduced latency by ~18% on the data pipeline — led execution across infra and infra‑adjacent teams.
- Recommendation: Hire (strong), would rehire.

Michael Chan (product PM) — 30m, phone
- Scope: partner on two product launches, focused on instrumentation and rollout.
- Strengths: pragmatic tradeoffs, good at scoping MVPs and reducing scope creep, receptive to feedback.
- Areas: prefers synchronous communication; on large cross-team programs may need a clearer escalation plan.
- Example: helped unblock a release by fixing a gating bug and coordinating triage across teams.
- Recommendation: Hire (recommended).

Laura — overall, both refs highlighted ramp + ownership with small coaching needs; I’m tagging these as positive inputs for the offer packet. Let me know if you want the raw questionnaire responses — Dana said she can send the filled PDF if we request it.

— Vivek
Principal Talent Partner
Redwood Inference
